messages.subject: Clark Fitzgerald on R and the Shell tomorrow, 10am in Shields 362
parts:
Hey D-ruggies,

Clark’s presentation on integrating R and the Shell is tomorrow at our D-RUG session!  Also, please note we'll be meeting in the small conference room (362) from now on.

From Clark:

“I’ll provide some motivation and examples of integrating R with the command line, including tools like Rscript, system2(), and commandArgs(). If users have specific tasks or questions please bring them and we’ll work on them together.”

After his talk we'll have our regular work session until 12pm.  Bring your questions!

Best,

Myfanwy

​
--

Myfanwy Johnston
Ph.D Candidate, UC Davis
Animal Behavior Graduate Group
Biotelemetry Laboratory
